description: Motion after massimo-v4: Apple's spring presets sampled into CSS linear() easings over the time each takes to settle, so the curve is the spring itself, plus ease curves for color and opacity. --motion-duration and --motion-easing are Affine's single state-change pair, pointed at the fade.

method.spring: x(t) = 1 − e^(−ζωt)(cos ω_d t + (ζω/ω_d) sin ω_d t), ω = 2π / response, ζ = 1 − bounce (critically damped when bounce is 0). Sampled at 41 points from 0 to the settling time.
method.settle: The time the spring stays within 0.1% of its target.
method.duration: Each spring runs in 80% of its settling time (Massimo: buttons and menus felt slow at 100%).
method.fade: Color and opacity have no distance to travel: they take 160ms on the standard ease.

springs.use: No overshoot: the default for anything that moves (a sliding thumb, a sheet).
A small overshoot: quick, direct feedback (a toggle, a pressed key's return).
A visible overshoot: playful moments only.

curves.use: Apple's standard ease, for color and opacity.

state.use: Affine's one state-change length; what the transition classes use by default.

reducedMotion: The reset cuts every animation and transition to 0.01ms under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
